title: Find depots
description: Payload schema for finding depots. The filters combine with AND, and mean what they mean in the depots/get query. authValues requires the serviceId of an internal verifiable_presentation issuer service

authValues.description: Finds the depots whose auth values equal any of these. Each item holds one depot's auth values, as depots/create takes them: one value per auth rule, in valueIndex order. They match as authentication matches them: strings trimmed and lower-cased, numbers and booleans unchanged. Only depots created under the service's current auth rules match
